name: John Paul Drayer
office: Bellflower Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2

items.text: John Paul Drayer is a teacher, counselor and businessman running for the Bellflower Unified School District Governing Board, Trustee Area No. 2. He served on the Cerritos College Board of Trustees from 2012 to 2017, representing an area including Bellflower. He retired from the Los Angeles Unified School District and now teaches part-time for the Los Alamitos School District.

sentences.text: John Paul Drayer is a teacher, counselor and businessman running for the Bellflower Unified School District Governing Board, Trustee Area No. 2.
He served on the Cerritos College Board of Trustees from 2012 to 2017, representing an area including Bellflower.
He retired from the Los Angeles Unified School District and now teaches part-time for the Los Alamitos School District.

items.text: He supports balancing the district’s budget to avoid a state takeover, following state audit guidelines, and increasing student enrollment. His website calls for school safety measures, fiscal transparency through community forums, and reducing financial burdens on families. He says his Cerritos College board service gave him experience with budgets, student success and building projects.
